main.title: Pokémon
main.blurb: Every Pokémon side by side at its real size, from the smallest at 0.1 m to Eternamax Eternatus at 100 m, in a sunny Lumiose City. Line them up by height, weight or any base stat, play the glide, explore, compare any of them, or make your own size video.

blurbs.every-pokemon: All 1,025 Pokémon in one line, from 0.1 m to Eternamax Eternatus at 100 m.
blurbs.legendaries: Every Legendary and Mythical Pokémon side by side, ending with Eternamax Eternatus.
blurbs.starters: All 27 starter lines, Bulbasaur to Quaquaval, from first stage to final evolution.
blurbs.eeveelutions: Eevee and its eight evolutions, Vaporeon to Sylveon.
blurbs.gen-1: The original 151, from Diglett to Onix.
blurbs.gigantamax: Every Gigantamax form at its Pokédex height (each a minimum), with Eternamax Eternatus at the end.
blurbs.bigger-than-a-house: Every Pokémon over 6.2 m, the height of a two-storey house.
blurbs.smaller-than-your-phone: Every Pokémon shorter than a smartphone (an iPhone 16 is 147.6 mm).

footer: Heights and weights from the Pokédex (PokéAPI); Gigantamax heights are the Pokédex's minimum. Long Pokémon such as serpents and fish are measured by length. Base stats from the Pokédex, and each Mega, regional and Gigantamax form's own from Pokémon Showdown's data. Real-world sizes are documented figures, each with its source.
